title: India just ran its first homemade hydrogen train
sources: Deccan Herald - India's first hydrogen-powered train set for inaugural run on July 17
Angel One - India to Launch First Hydrogen Powered Train on July 17, 2026
caption:
India just ran its first homemade hydrogen train. Built entirely in-house, running real passengers every day.

India's first domestically built hydrogen-powered passenger train was flagged off on July 17, 2026 on the Jind-Sonipat route in Haryana, with regular commercial service starting two days later. The 10-coach train runs on a 1,200 kW fuel cell system, covering 356 km daily at up to 75 km/h, backed by a dedicated hydrogen refuelling facility built at Jind.

Most countries with hydrogen trains imported the technology. India built its own, then put it straight into daily passenger service.
